notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
More than 1800 people played our debut game! We didn't expect that! Thank you so much!

We are keep working on the improvements and new features. We've heard your feedback and updated a few things to make the game experience better:
- Security Guy found a knife and can attack in melee now
- aiming with a rifle became easier
- a few bugs were smashed
- difficulty changed

Update 1.2 is coming shortly
